roles/iam.dataScientist.title: Data Scientist
roles/iam.dataScientist.desc: Designed for a data scientist power user to manage data platform services and associated Compute services for analyzing data and building data processing, transformation and analysis pipelines.

roles/iam.databasesAdmin.title: Databases Admin
roles/iam.databasesAdmin.desc: Role for an administrator to manage all structured and non structured datastores in GCP.

roles/iam.devOps.title: Dev Ops
roles/iam.devOps.desc: Enables DevOps users to build and deploy applications, create, manage and perform administrative tasks on associated GCP resources

roles/iam.infrastructureAdmin.title: Infrastructure Administrator
roles/iam.infrastructureAdmin.desc: Enables full control for management of key infrastructure services: GCE, GKE, Storage and Networking

roles/iam.mlEngineer.title: ML Engineer
roles/iam.mlEngineer.desc: Enables an ML engineer as a power user for using GCP for building and deploying AI based applications.

roles/iam.networkAdmin.title: Network Administrator
roles/iam.networkAdmin.desc: Designed for a Network Administrator to manage Network and related GCP resources, create customized monitoring, and viewing configurations

roles/iam.securityAuditor.title: Security Auditor
roles/iam.securityAuditor.desc: Read-only role designed for enabling security audit of your GCP environment, associated policies and viewing configurations.

roles/iam.siteReliabilityEngineer.title: Site Reliability Engineer
roles/iam.siteReliabilityEngineer.desc: Enables operational monitoring, performance optimization and reliability management of applications built on GCP.

roles/iam.supportUser.title: Support User
roles/iam.supportUser.desc: Provide a user the ability to create and manage support cases in their own enterprise by viewing their GCP resource configurations, monitoring and logging information that may be needed for providing required information to GCP support.
